opening.argument: The presentation prominently markets XRP as a route to passive income, stating there is potential to earn it by "staking your XRP and lending it back to the network" and portraying liquidity providers as able to receive a large share of profits. Although the speaker later cautions that XRP cannot currently be staked and describes the returns only as potential, the video still directs viewers toward financial referral offers for free BTC and a free stock, as well as paid Patreon access containing trading information and crypto trading bots. Those links create explicit paths to financial products or services. The disclaimers, research warnings, and absence of any established recipient, completed transaction, user loss, or promoted-offer outcome limit what can be claimed, but do not remove the investment-promotion structure.
